artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a man in a three-quarter view. He wears a broad-brimmed hat and a richly embroidered robe with a high, ornate, white ruff around his neck. His facial features include a short, trimmed beard and mustache, and he appears to be middle-aged with a composed expression. His hair is relatively long, dark, and slightly wavy, peeking out from under the hat. The background is plain, with a cursive text below the portrait on the mat reading "frt. verulom ca." The image is on pale paper with a few small age blemishes and spots.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount, Saint Albans

He has a mustache, short beard, high cheekbones, and a solemn expression. His hair is wavy and shoulder-length. The man wears a large black hat, a ruffled collar, and a richly patterned dark garment with lace and brocade. The background has horizontal lines and the text above reads "Francis Bacon Visct. St. Albans."

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon

He wears a hat that reveals slightly wavy hair. His attire includes a ruffled collar, a textured cloak with patterned sleeves, and the text reads "Sr. Francis Bacon" below the portrait.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a man from the waist up, facing the left. He wears a tall dark hat with a fabric bow above it. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, small slightly downturned eyes, and a serious expression. His hair is wavy and visible under the hat. He wears a richly decorated garment with ornate patterns on the sleeves and a pleated ruff around his neck. The background is a simple oval gray area with a plain backdrop and aged spots. Below the portrait, the text "LORD BACON" is inscribed in capital letters.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon

The man has a beard and mustache, and his hair is styled with soft waves under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a large, ruffled collar and an ornate garment with decorative puffs on the shoulders. The background is plain, with no distinct features, and the name "Bacon" is below the portrait. A faint rectangular border surrounds the portrait area.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of Lord Bacon, seated or standing in a slightly angled pose, facing the viewer with a composed expression. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with curly hair partially visible beneath a large, intricately patterned hat. Lord Bacon is wearing historical attire with a richly detailed robe, a ruffled collar, and decorative sleeves, suggesting a status of nobility or importance. The background is a dark tone, contrasting with his lighter-colored clothing and hat. The overall style is a classic, finely detailed engraving.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person in period clothing, facing forward with the head slightly turned to the right. The individual has distinctive facial features with a beard and mustache, styled hair, a large black hat, an elaborate ruffled collar, and a dark, textured garment with patterns and buttons. The background is plain, with the name "Bacon" written under the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon, Lord Chancellor
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat. He has distinguished facial features with a pointed beard and mustache, and medium-length hair. He is wearing a richly textured garment with designs on the sleeves and buttons, and a large ruff collar around his neck. The background is a simple oval frame. The text below the portrait identifies him as "Sr Francis Bacon, Lord Chancellor."

artworks.title: Bacon Lord Verulam
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of Bacon, Lord Verulam. He is depicted from the shoulders up in an oval frame, facing slightly to the left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, wavy shoulder-length hair, and a distinguished expression. Bacon wears a large, dark hat with a tall crown and broad brim, along with a detailed doublet with braided embellishments and an elaborate ruff collar. The background within the oval frame is plain, highlighting the figure, and the surrounding area on the page is plain, textured paper. The name "BACON Lord VERULAM" is inscribed beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Francis Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Francis Lord Bacon, Viscount St. Albans, displaying his upper body turned slightly to the side. He has a beard and mustache, with medium-length, wavy hair. He is wearing a high-crowned hat, a garment with a ruff collar, and an embroidered coat or cloak. There are no objects or jewelry in his hands or on his person. The background is plain, with the portrait set in an oval on an unembellished sheet marked "No 1" in the corner. Below the oval, a smaller engraving shows a historical scene with text reading "Francis Lord Bacon, Viscount St Albans" and additional publishing details.

artworks.title: Francis Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Francis Lord Bacon, Viscount St Albans. He is facing slightly to his left, looking directly at the viewer with a solemn expression. He has a trimmed beard and mustache, medium-length hair slightly curled under a tall hat. He wears a dark garment with a textured pattern and a large white ruffled collar. The background features an oval frame against a light brown, spotted texture. Below the portrait is a detailed illustration showing an interior scene with an empty chair and two figures. Text under the portrait identifies the person as "Francis Lord Bacon, Viscount St Albans."

The man is positioned slightly turned to his right, facing towards the viewer. He wears a dark, broad-brimmed hat and a garment with elaborate patterns, along with a large, ruffled collar. The background is plain with draped fabric.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: J. Cochran after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view, displaying most of his upper body. He stands at a slight tilt, with his left hand touching a table-like structure. His right arm rests by his side. The man has defining facial features, a short beard, and mustache, with a neutral expression. His medium-length hair curls slightly, and he wears a wide-brimmed, dark hat tilted forward on his head. The man is dressed in an elaborate outfit with a dark, richly embroidered coat, adorned with intricate patterns and large cuffs. He also wears a large ruff around his neck. The portrait is surrounded by an intricate decorative border, and the backdrop appears to be a draped curtain.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man seated, likely Sir Francis Bacon, based on the inscription. He is facing forward with his gaze slightly to the side. The man has a mustache, a short beard, curly hair under a broad-brimmed hat, a ruffled collar, and an elaborately patterned robe. His right arm is on a table, holding a large book labeled "Novum Organum." The background features a decorated archway. Below the portrait are a crown, scepter, and royal symbols with his titles. The art reflects typical 17th-century engraving style and emphasizes the subject's importance.

artworks.title: Francois Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body. He is slightly turned to the right, with a neutral expression. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair, a full beard, prominent cheekbones, and a high forehead. He is wearing a high ruffed collar and an elaborately embroidered coat. The background is a simple oval shape within a rectangular frame. The text "FRANÇOIS BACON" is written below the image, and there are artist signatures along the bottom edge of the oval.

artworks.title: Monument of the Lord Chancellor Bacon, Saint Michael's Church
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated figure of a man in elaborate clothing, including a ruffled collar, doublet, and breeches. The man is in a relaxed pose, with one arm resting on the armrest of the chair and head supported by his hand. The sculpture is monochromatic and likely made of stone. The detailed attire and facial features are emphasized by a textured surface. The sculpture is housed within a recessed, arched niche, highlighting its prominence. The figure's composition and positioning are typical of memorial sculptures.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated man in elaborate attire. He is dressed in detailed outfit featuring puffy sleeves, a prominent ruffled collar, and a lavish coat adorned with intricate decorations. The man's head reclines slightly to the side, resting on one hand. His feet are adorned with ornate shoes, resting on a platform. The sculpture, made of a monochromatic material, appears to be set within an architectural alcove resembling an archway. In front of the figure, a plaque with engraved text completes the presentation.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount St. Alban
artworks.description: The image shows a man identified as Francis Bacon, Viscount St Alban. He is standing and slightly turned to the right, with one hand on a surface and the other hanging by his side. He has a well-groomed beard and mustache, long curly hair, and wears a wide-brimmed hat. His attire includes an elaborate cloak with detailed patterns and a large ruff around his neck. The background is a draped curtain, and the image includes text detailing his title and publication information.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: Robert Cooper after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a man identified as Francis Bacon, Viscount St Alban. He is standing with his body turned slightly, looking towards the viewer. He has a well-groomed face with a short beard and mustache, wearing a dark, wide-brimmed hat above his wavy hair. He is dressed in an intricately decorated overcoat with embroidered patterns, a lace ruff collar, and is holding a letter in his left hand. The background features draped curtains, and the paper shows signs of aging and discoloration.

artworks.title: The Essays or Counsels of Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a man from the waist up, positioned slightly to the side but facing forward. He has a beard and mustache, with curly hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a ruff around his neck and a detailed garment. Surrounding the portrait are printed text and details, identifying the image as the title page for "The Essays or Counsels of Sir Francis Bacon," printed in 1817 by John Booth in London. The background outside of the portrait is plain, with decorative fonts enhancing the historical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Lord Chancellor Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a full bust portrait of a seated man identified as Lord Chancellor Bacon. He is positioned facing forward with his body slightly angled to the right. His facial features include a long face with a mustache and beard, gazing directly at the viewer. His hair appears to be curly or wavy, extending to the sides, and he wears a tall hat with some decorative elements on top. Lord Chancellor Bacon is attired in a detailed garment with puffed sleeves and a richly patterned fabric, complemented by a wide, ornate lace collar. He is wearing a ring on his finger and a buttoned up garment. He is holding an open book and is seated in a high-backed chair. To his left, there is a scientific apparatus on a table. The background is a simple textured pattern, and the image is framed within a rectangular border, with text below describing the scene. The paper has a sepia tone with some aging marks.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait engraving of a man from the chest up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has a mustache, beard, wavy hair under his hat, and a neutral expression. He wears a high-collared, ruffled shirt under a dark, intricately patterned garment with embellishments on the shoulders. He also wears a large, round-brimmed hat. The portrait is within an oval frame with the label "Fr. Bacon" below it. The background has a textured surface, and below the oval frame, a plinth displays "Fr. Bacon" in capital letters. The image is surrounded by a plain border on the paper.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a person facing forward with a neutral expression. The person has shoulder-length, wavy hair and a short, pointed beard, and is depicted wearing an elaborate garment with an ornate, ruffled collar. The garment features detailed patterns on the shoulders. In front of the bust is a rectangular stone-like surface with the word "BACON" inscribed on it, accompanied by items resembling scientific instruments on either side. The background consists of shaded, cloudy textures creating a contrast with the figure. The person is not wearing any jewelry, and the scene conveys a classical, engraved portrait style.

artworks.title: Francis, Lord Bacon
artworks.artist: James Fittler after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing the upper body of a man standing. He has distinct facial features, with a beard, mustache, and shoulder-length curly hair. He wears a dark embroidered robe with a white lace collar, ornate details on the sleeves, and lace cuffs. He is holding a document in his right hand, resting it on a table with a patterned cloth. The background features a heavy draped curtain. A caption below the image identifies the man as "Francis Lord Bacon," engraved by James Fittler.
